ko.title: 다음 노벨 경제학상: 어떤 거대한 아이디어가 수상할 수 있으며, 왜 그것이 당신의 지갑에 중요한가

segments.src: After a week of announcements in science and peace, attention turns to the last of the major Nobel awards: the Prize in Economic Sciences, formally the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
segments.tr: 과학과 평화 부문의 발표 주간이 지나고, 이제 주요 노벨상 중 마지막인 경제학상(알프레드 노벨을 기념하는 스베리예스 릭스반크 경제학상)으로 관심이 쏠립니다.

segments.src: The committee never publishes a shortlist, so any list of contenders is educated guessing.
segments.tr: 위원회는 후보 명단을 절대 공개하지 않으므로, 유력 후보에 대한 어떤 목록도 교육받은 추측일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Still, the research areas that tend to come up in these conversations say a lot about the questions economists are working on, and about the forces that shape prices, paychecks and job prospects.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 이러한 대화에서 자주 등장하는 연구 분야는 경제학자들이 다루고 있는 질문들과 물가, 급여, 취업 전망을 형성하는 힘에 대해 많은 것을 말해줍니다.

segments.src: ## First, a quick caveat
segments.tr: ## 먼저, 간단한 주의 사항

segments.src: The selection process is confidential, and nominations stay sealed for decades.
segments.tr: 선정 과정은 기밀이며 후보 지명은 수십 년 동안 비공개로 유지됩니다.

segments.src: Commentators build their lists from citation counts, past awards and the themes dominating the field.
segments.tr: 논평가들은 인용 횟수, 과거 수상 내역, 그리고 해당 분야를 지배하는 주제를 바탕으로 목록을 작성합니다.

segments.src: Treat the areas below as a guide to where economics is heading, not as a forecast of who will win.
segments.tr: 아래의 분야들은 누가 수상할 것인가에 대한 예측이 아니라, 경제학이 향하고 있는 방향에 대한 지침으로 삼으세요.

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## 자주 논의되는 연구 분야

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income
segments.tr: ### 1. 불평등과 소득 분배

segments.src: Why do some households pull ahead while others stall?
segments.tr: 왜 어떤 가계는 앞서 나가는 반면 다른 가계는 정체될까요?

segments.src: Work on wealth concentration, intergenerational mobility and the changing share of income going to labor versus capital has shaped debates about taxes, education funding and social programs.
segments.tr: 부의 집중, 세대 간 이동성, 그리고 노동 대 자본에 돌아가는 소득 몫의 변화에 관한 연구는 세금, 교육 재정, 사회 프로그램에 관한 논쟁을 형성해 왔습니다.

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: 일반 독자들에게 이 연구는 임금이 생활비를 따라잡고 있는지, 그리고 조세 정책이 실수령액에 어떤 영향을 미치는지와 같은 질문들의 이면에 자리 잡고 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects
segments.tr: ### 2. 무역, 세계화 그리고 그 지역적 영향

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: 수입, 관세, 공급망이 특정 도시와 산업에 미치는 영향을 연구하는 학자들은 대화의 흐름을 바꾸어 놓았습니다.

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: 무역으로부터 얻는 이익은 실재하지만 고르게 분배되지 않는다는 발견은 무역 정책이 왜 그토록 논란이 되는지 설명하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: 또한 이는 상점 진열대의 상품 가격과 어떤 지역 일자리가 성장하고 축소되는지에서도 나타납니다.

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. AI, 자동화 및 생산성

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: 신기술이 생산성과 생활 수준을 높일 수 있을까요, 그리고 그럴 때 혜택을 받는 사람은 누구일까요?

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 자동화가 단순히 일자리의 수가 아니라 근로자들이 수행하는 업무를 어떻게 바꾸는지 조사하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: 가계의 핵심 질문은 실용적입니다. 도구가 개선됨에 따라 임금이 오를 것인가, 그리고 어떤 기술이 그 가치를 유지할 것인가?

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: 증거는 여전히 발전하고 있으며, 이것이 이 주제가 그토록 많은 주목을 받는 이유 중 일부입니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. 노동 시장과 임금 결정 방식

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: 고용, 직장 간 이동, 교섭력, 최저임금에 대한 연구는 경제학자들이 임금에 대해 생각하는 방식을 바꾸어 놓았습니다.

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: 이러한 연구 계보는 정책 입안자들이 고용을 바라보는 시각에 정보를 제공하며, 독자들이 급여를 협상하거나 경력 전환을 고민할 때 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. 화폐, 인플레이션 및 중앙은행

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간의 고물가는 통화 경제학을 다시 스포트라이트의 중심으로 이끌었습니다.

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: 기대, 금리, 그리고 중앙은행의 소통 방식에 관한 연구는 주택담보대출, 자동차 대출, 신용카드의 차입 비용이 왜 그렇게 움직이는지 설명하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. 기후, 에너지 및 환경 경제학

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: 오염에 가격을 매기고, 인센티브를 설계하며, 기후 변화의 비용을 측정하는 것은 이제 핵심적인 경제적 질문입니다.

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: 이는 에너지 요금, 보험 비용, 그리고 투자 결정의 장기적 비용에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## 과거 수상자의 아이디어가 현실 세계의 정책이 된 방식

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: 이 상은 종종 학술 저널에서 일상의 제도로 이동한 연구에 영예를 안겨주었습니다:

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **은행과 금융 안정성 (2022):** 벤 버냉키, 더글러스 다이아몬드, 필립 디비그는 은행과 금융 위기에 관한 연구로 인정받았습니다. 대공황에 대한 버냉키의 연구는 긴급 대출 및 예금 보호 사고를 포함하여 2008년 위기에 대한 중앙은행들의 대응에 정보를 제공했습니다.

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **자연 실험 (2021):** 데이비드 카드, 조슈아 앵그리스트, 구이도 임벤스는 현실 세계의 사건들이 인과관계를 어떻게 드러낼 수 있는지 보여주었습니다. 예를 들어 최저임금에 대한 카드의 연구는 인상이 항상 일자리를 앗아간다는 가정에 도전했으며 임금 논쟁에 사용되는 증거를 형성했습니다.

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **개발과 빈곤 (2019):** 아비지트 바네지, 에스테르 뒤플로, 마이클 크레이머는 어떤 반빈곤 프로그램이 효과가 있는지 테스트하기 위해 무작위 대조 실험을 대중화했습니다. 정부와 자선 단체들은 이제 일상적으로 이러한 방식으로 프로그램을 평가합니다.

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **성별과 일 (2023):** 여성의 노동 참가율과 임금 격정에 관한 클라우디아 골딘의 역사적 연구는 직장 정책과 가족 관련 경력 비용에 대한 진행 중인 논의에 정보를 제공했습니다.

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **제도와 번영 (2024):** 다론 아제모글루, 사이먼 존슨, 제임스 로빈슨은 국가 제도의 질을 장기적인 경제적 결과와 연결했습니다.

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **혁신과 성장 (2025):** 조엘 모키르, 필립 아기온, 피터 하위트는 기술 진보가 지속적인 성장을 이끄는 방식에 관한 연구로 영예를 안았으며, 이는 오늘의 AI 대화와 밀접하게 연관된 주제입니다.

segments.src: ## Why this matters for your wallet
segments.tr: ## 이것이 당신의 지갑에 중요한 이유

segments.src: It is easy to dismiss a prize announcement as an academic event.
segments.tr: 수상자 발표를 학술적 행사로 치부하기는 쉽습니다.

segments.src: But the ideas behind it tend to show up in:
segments.tr: 그러나 그 이면의 아이디어들은 종종 다음과 같은 곳에 나타납니다:

segments.src: - **Interest rates and borrowing costs**, shaped by how central banks understand inflation.
segments.tr: - **금리 및 차입 비용**, 중앙은행이 인플레이션을 이해하는 방식에 의해 형성됩니다.

segments.src: - **Wages and job security**, shaped by research on labor markets, trade and technology.
segments.tr: - **임금 및 고용 안정성**, 노동 시장, 무역, 기술에 관한 연구에 의해 형성됩니다.

segments.src: - **Taxes and public programs**, shaped by evidence on inequality and what policies actually work.
segments.tr: - **세금 및 공공 프로그램**, 불평등에 대한 증거와 어떤 정책이 실제로 효과가 있는지에 의해 형성됩니다.

segments.src: - **Prices**, shaped by trade rules, competition policy and energy markets.
segments.tr: - **물가**, 무역 규칙, 경쟁 정책, 에너지 시장에 의해 형성됩니다.

segments.src: You do not need to follow every paper to benefit from knowing the basics.
segments.tr: 기본적인 내용을 아는 것의 혜택을 누리기 위해 모든 논문을 쫓아다닐 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: When the winners are announced, look for the plain-language explanation the committee publishes alongside the award.
segments.tr: 수상자가 발표되면, 위원회가 수상과 함께 발표하는 평이한 언어로 된 설명을 찾아보세요.

segments.src: It usually summarizes the contribution in a few accessible pages.
segments.tr: 보통 접근하기 쉬운 몇 페이지에 기여도가 요약되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch for
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **The announcement itself:** the economics prize is traditionally announced on a Monday in October, after the other Nobel categories.
segments.tr: - **발표 자체:** 경제학상은 전통적으로 다른 노벨상 부문들이 발표된 후 10월의 어느 월요일에 발표됩니다.

segments.src: - **The citation:** the committee's wording reveals which idea it considers most important.
segments.tr: - **인용구:**위원회의 문구는 어떤 아이디어를 가장 중요하게 여기는지 드러냅니다.

segments.src: - **The policy angle:** pay attention to how commentators connect the winning work to current debates on inflation, jobs and technology.
segments.tr: - **정책적 시각:** 논평가들이 수상 연구를 인플레이션, 일자리, 기술에 대한 현재의 논쟁과 어떻게 연결하는지 주목하세요.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Whoever is honored, the prize is a reminder that economic ideas have practical consequences.
segments.tr: 누가 영예를 안든, 이 상은 경제적 아이디어가 실질적인 결과를 가져온다는 것을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: The research areas above are not abstract; they are tied to the cost of living, the job market and the choices governments make.
segments.tr: 위의 연구 분야들은 추상적인 것이 아니라, 생활비, 노동 시장, 그리고 정부가 내리는 선택들과 묶여 있습니다.

segments.src: Following the announcement is a simple way to learn what economists think matters most right now.
segments.tr: 발표를 팔로우하는 것은 경제학자들이 지금 가장 중요하다고 생각하는 것이 무엇인지 배우는 간단한 방법입니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and discussion only.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 및 토론 목적으로만 제공됩니다.

segments.src: It is not financial, investment or tax advice, and it does not predict the outcome of the prize.*
segments.tr: 이는 재정적, 투자적 또는 세무적 조언이 아니며, 상의 결과를 예측하지 않습니다.*

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## 经常被讨论的研究领域

segments.tr: ### 1. 不平等与收入分配

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: 研究进口、关税和供应链如何影响特定城镇和行业的学者改变了对话方式。

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: 贸易收益是真实的但分布不均这一发现有助于解释为什么贸易政策如此受争议。

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: 它也体现在商店货架上的商品价格以及哪些地方就业岗位在增加或减少中。

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. 人工智能、自动化与生产力

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: 新技术能否提高生产力和生活水平，当它做到这一点时谁会受益？

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: 经济学家正在研究自动化如何改变工人所做的工作任务，而不仅仅是工作岗位的数量。

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: 对家庭而言，核心问题是实际的：随着工具的改进工资会上升吗，哪些技能能保持其价值？

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: 证据仍在不断发展中，这也是该主题引起如此多关注的部分原因。

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. 劳动力市场与工资的确定方式

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: 对招聘、工作间流动、议价能力和最低工资的研究改变了经济学家对薪酬的看法。

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: 这一系列研究为政策制定者如何看待就业提供了参考，当读者协商薪水或权衡职业转型时，它会直接影响他们。

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. 货币、通货膨胀与中央银行

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: 近年来高通胀使货币经济学重新成为焦点。

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: 关于预期、利率以及中央银行如何沟通的研究有助于解释为什么抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡的借贷成本会按其方式变动。

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. 气候、能源与环境经济学

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: 对污染定价、设计激励措施以及衡量气候变化成本现在是核心经济学问题。

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: 它们影响着能源账单、保险成本以及投资决策的长期成本。

segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## 过去获奖者的构想如何成为现实世界的政策

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: 该奖项经常表彰从学术期刊走向日常机构的工作：

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **银行与金融稳定（2022）：** 本·伯南克、道格拉斯·戴蒙德和菲利普·迪布维格因对银行和金融危机的研究而受到表彰。伯南克关于大萧条的研究为中央银行对2008年危机的反应提供了信息，包括紧急贷款和存款保护思维。

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **自然实验（2021）：** 大卫·卡德、约书亚·安格里斯特和圭多·因本斯展示了现实世界的事件如何揭示因果关系。例如，卡德对最低工资的研究挑战了增加总是会牺牲就业岗位的假设，并塑造了工资辩论中使用的证据。

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **发展与贫困（2019）：** 阿比吉特·班纳吉、埃丝特·迪弗洛和迈ケル·克雷默普及了随机对照试验，以测试哪些反贫困项目有效。政府和慈善机构现在常规地以这种方式评估项目。

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **性别与工作（2023）：** 克劳迪娅·戈尔丁关于女性劳动力参与率和薪酬差距的历史研究，为关于工作场所政策和家庭相关职业成本的持续讨论提供了参考。

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **制度与繁荣（2024）：** 达龙·阿西莫格鲁、西蒙·约翰逊和詹姆斯·罗宾逊将一个国家的制度质量与长期经济成果联系起来。

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **创新与增长（2025）：** 乔尔·莫基尔、菲利普·阿吉翁和彼得·霍威特因关于技术进步如何推动持续增长的研究而受到表彰，这是一个与当今人工智能对话紧密相关的主题。

segments.src: ## Why this matters for your wallet
segments.tr: ## 为什么这对你的钱包很重要

segments.tr: 人们很容易将奖项公布视为一项学术活动。

es.title: El próximo Nobel de Economía: qué grandes ideas podrían ganar y por qué importan a tu bolsillo

segments.src: After a week of announcements in science and peace, attention turns to the last of the major Nobel awards: the Prize in Economic Sciences, formally the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
segments.tr: Tras una semana de anuncios en ciencia y paz, la atención se dirige al último de los principales premios Nobel: el Premio de Ciencias Económicas, oficialmente denominado Premio de Ciencias Económicas del Sveriges Riksbank en Memoria de Alfred Nobel.

segments.src: The committee never publishes a shortlist, so any list of contenders is educated guessing.
segments.tr: El comité nunca publica una lista de candidatos, por lo que cualquier lista de aspirantes es solo una conjetura fundamentada.

segments.src: Still, the research areas that tend to come up in these conversations say a lot about the questions economists are working on, and about the forces that shape prices, paychecks and job prospects.
segments.tr: Aun así, las áreas de investigación que suelen surgir en estas conversaciones dicen mucho sobre las preguntas en las que trabajan los economistas y sobre las fuerzas que moldean los precios, las nóminas y las perspectivas laborales.

segments.src: ## First, a quick caveat
segments.tr: ## En primer lugar, una breve advertencia

segments.src: The selection process is confidential, and nominations stay sealed for decades.
segments.tr: El proceso de selección es confidencial y las nominaciones permanecen secretas durante décadas.

segments.src: Commentators build their lists from citation counts, past awards and the themes dominating the field.
segments.tr: Los comentaristas elaboran sus listas a partir de recuentos de citas, premios anteriores y los temas que dominan el campo.

segments.src: Treat the areas below as a guide to where economics is heading, not as a forecast of who will win.
segments.tr: Considere las siguientes áreas como una guía de hacia dónde se dirige la economía, no como un pronóstico de quién ganará.

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## Áreas de investigación que se debaten a menudo

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income
segments.tr: ### 1. Desigualdad y distribución del ingreso

segments.src: Why do some households pull ahead while others stall?
segments.tr: ¿Por qué algunos hogares salen adelante mientras otros se estancan?

segments.src: Work on wealth concentration, intergenerational mobility and the changing share of income going to labor versus capital has shaped debates about taxes, education funding and social programs.
segments.tr: El trabajo sobre la concentración de la riqueza, la movilidad intergeneracional y la variación en la participación del ingreso entre el trabajo y el capital ha dado forma a los debates sobre impuestos, financiación educativa y programas sociales.

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: Para los lectores de a pie, esta investigación subyace a preguntas como si los salarios se mantienen al ritmo del coste de vida y cómo influye la política fiscal en el salario neto.

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects
segments.tr: ### 2. Comercio, globalización y sus efectos locales

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: Los investigadores que estudian cómo las importaciones, los aranceles y las cadenas de suministro afectan a ciudades e industrias específicas han cambiado el debate.

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: El hallazgo de que los beneficios del comercio son reales pero están distribuidos de forma desigual ayuda a explicar por qué la política comercial es tan discutida.

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: También se refleja en el precio de los productos en los estantes de las tiendas y en qué empleos locales crecen o se reducen.

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. IA, automatización y productividad

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: ¿Pueden las nuevas tecnologías elevar la productividad y el nivel de vida, y quién se beneficia cuando lo hacen?

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: Los economistas están examinando cómo la automatización cambia las tareas que realizan los trabajadores, no solo el número de empleos.

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: La cuestión central para los hogares es práctica: ¿subirán los salarios a medida que mejoren las herramientas y qué habilidades mantendrán su valor?

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: La evidencia aún se está desarrollando, lo cual es parte de la razón por la que el tema atrae tanta atención.

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. Mercados de trabajo y fijación de salarios

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: Los estudios sobre contratación, movilidad entre empleos, poder de negociación y salarios mínimos han cambiado la forma en que los economistas entienden la retribución.

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: Esta línea de trabajo orienta la visión de los responsables políticos sobre el empleo y afecta directamente a los lectores cuando negocian un sueldo o sopesan un cambio de carrera.

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. Dinero, inflación y banca central

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: Los últimos años de alta inflación han devuelto la economía monetaria al primer plano.

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: La investigación sobre las expectativas, los tipos de interés y la forma en que se comunican los bancos centrales ayuda a explicar por qué los costes de endeudamiento en hipotecas, préstamos para automóviles y tarjetas de crédito cambian de la forma en que lo hacen.

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. Clima, energía y economía ambiental

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: Fijar el precio de la contaminación, diseñar incentivos y medir los costes de un clima cambiante son ahora cuestiones económicas fundamentales.

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: Influyen en las facturas de energía, los costes de los seguros y el coste a largo plazo de las decisiones de inversión.

segments.tr: ## Cómo las ideas de ganadores pasados se convirtieron en políticas del mundo real

segments.tr: بعد أسبوع من الإعلانات في العلوم والسلام، يتحول الانتباه إلى آخر جوائز نوبل الكبرى: جائزة العلوم الاقتصادية، والمعرّفة رسمياً بجائزة بنك السويد المركزي في العلوم الاقتصادية ذكري ألفريد نوبل.

segments.src: The committee never publishes a shortlist, so any list of contenders is educated guessing.
segments.tr: لا تنشر اللجنة أبداً قائمة مرشحين قصيرة، لذا فإن أي قائمة للمرشحين هي تخمين مبني على معرفة.

segments.src: Still, the research areas that tend to come up in these conversations say a lot about the questions economists are working on, and about the forces that shape prices, paychecks and job prospects.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، فإن مجالات البحث التي تميل للظهور في هذه النقاشات تقول الكثير عن الأسئلة التي يعمل عليها الاقتصاديون، وعن القوى التي تشكل الأسعار والأجور وآفاق الوظائف.

segments.src: ## First, a quick caveat
segments.tr: ## أولاً، تنويه سريع

segments.src: The selection process is confidential, and nominations stay sealed for decades.
segments.tr: عملية الاختيار سرية، وتظل الترشيحات مكتومة لعقود.

segments.src: Commentators build their lists from citation counts, past awards and the themes dominating the field.
segments.tr: يبني المعلقون قوائمهم من عدد الاستشهادات، والجوائز السابقة، والموضوعات المهيمنة على المجال.

segments.src: Treat the areas below as a guide to where economics is heading, not as a forecast of who will win.
segments.tr: تعامل مع المجالات أدناه كدليل على اتجاه الاقتصاد، وليس كفحص تنبؤ لمن سيشرف بالفوز.

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## مجالات بحثية تتم مناقشتها غالباً

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income
segments.tr: ### 1. عدم المساواة وتوزيع الدخل

segments.src: Why do some households pull ahead while others stall?
segments.tr: لماذا تتقدم بعض الأسر بينما تتخلف أخرى؟

segments.src: Work on wealth concentration, intergenerational mobility and the changing share of income going to labor versus capital has shaped debates about taxes, education funding and social programs.
segments.tr: لقد شكل العمل على تركيز الثروة، والحراك بين الأجيال، والنسبة المتغيرة للدخل الموجه للعمل مقابل رأس المال، النقاشات حول الضرائب وتمويل التعليم والبرامج الاجتماعية.

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقراء العاديين، يكمن هذا البحث خلف أسئلة مثل ما إذا كانت الأجور تواكب تكلفة المعيشة وكيف تؤثر سياسة الضرائب على الأجر الصافي.

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects
segments.tr: ### 2. التجارة والعولمة وتأثيراتهما المحلية

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: لقد غير الباحثون الذين يدرسون كيف تؤثر الواردات والتعريفات الجمركية وسلاسل الإمداد على المدن والصناعات المحددة، مجرى المحادثة.

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: إن النتيجة القائلة بأن مكاسب التجارة حقيقية ولكنها موزعة بشكل غير متساوٍ تساعد في تفسير سبب شدة التنافس على سياسة التجارة.

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: كما يظهر ذلك في أسعار السلع على رفوف المتاجر وفي أي الوظائف المحلية تنمو أو تتقلص.

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. الذكاء الاصطناعي والأتمتة والإنتاجية

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: هل تستطيع التكنولوجيا الجديدة رفع الإنتاجية ومستويات المعيشة، ومن يستفيد عندما تفعل ذلك؟

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: يفحص الاقتصاديون كيف تغير الأتمتة المهام التي يؤديها العمال، وليس فقط عدد الوظائف.

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: السؤال المركزي للأسر عملي: هل ترتفع الأجور مع تحسن الأدوات، وأي المهارات تحافظ على قيمتها؟

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: لا تزال الأدلة في طور التطور، وهذا جزء من سبب جذب الموضوع للكثير من الاهتمام.

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. أسواق العمل وكيفية تحديد الأجور

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: لقد غيرت دراسات التوظيف، والتحولات من وظيفة لأخرى، والقوة التفاوضية، والحد الأدنى للأجور، كيف يفكر الاقتصاديون في الأجور.

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: يُعلم هذا الخط من العمل صانعي السياسات كيف ينظرون إلى التوظيف، وهو يؤثر على القراء بشكل مباشر عندما يتفاوضون على الرواتب أو يدرسون تغييراً في المسار المهني.

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. المال والتضخم والخدمات المصرفية المركزية

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: أعادت السنوات الأخيرة من التضخم المرتفع الاقتصاد النقدي إلى دائرة الضوء.

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: يساعد البحث حول التوقعات وأسعار الفائدة وكيف تتواصل البنوك المركزية في تفسير سبب تحرك تكاليف الاقتراض على الرهون العقارية وقروض السيارات بطرق محددة.

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. المناخ والطاقة والاقتصاد البيئي

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: تسعير التلوث، وتصميم الحوافز، وقياس تكاليف المناخ المتغير أصبحت الآن أسئلة اقتصادية أساسية.

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: وهي تؤثر على فواتير الطاقة، وتكاليف التأمين، والتكلفة طويلة الأجل لقرارات الاستثمار.

segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## كيف تحولت أفكار الفائزين السابقين إلى سياسة على أرض الواقع

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: غالباً ما كرمت الجائزة العمل الذي انتقل من المجلات الأكاديمية إلى المؤسسات اليومية:

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **الخدمات المصرفية والاستقرار المالي (2022):** تم تكريم بن برنانكي ودوглаس دياموند فيليب ديبفيغ للأبحاث حول البنوك والأزمات المالية. لقد ساهم عمل برنانكي حول الكسخ الكبير في توجيه استجابات البنوك المركزية لأزمة 2008.

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **التجارب الطبيعية (2021):** أظهر ديفيد كارد وجوشوا أنغريست وغويدو إمبنس كيف يمكن لأحداث العالم الحقيقي الكشف عن السبب والنتيجة.

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **التنمية والفقر (2019):** قام أبهيجيت بانيرجي وإستر دوفلو ومايكل كريمر بتعميم التجارب العشوائية لاختبار برامج مكافحة الفقر التي تنجح.

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **النوع الاجتماعي والعمل (2023):** ساهم بحث كلوديا غولدن التاريخي حول مشاركة النساء في القوة العاملة وفجوة الأجور في النقاشات الجارية حول سياسة مكان العمل.

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **المؤسسات والرخاء (2024):** ربط دارون أجموغلو وسيمون جونسون وجيمس روبنسون جودة مؤسسات الدولة بالنتائج الاقتصادية طويلة الأجل.

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **الابتكار والنمو (2025):** تم تكريم جويل موكير وفيليب أغيون وبيتر هويت للعمل على كيفية دفع التقدم التكنولوجي للنمو المستدام.

segments.src: ## Why this matters for your wallet
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم هذا لمحفظتك

segments.src: It is easy to dismiss a prize announcement as an academic event.
segments.tr: من السهل تجاهل إعلان الجائزة كحدث أكاديمي.

segments.src: But the ideas behind it tend to show up in:
segments.tr: لكن الأفكار الكامنة وراءها تميل للظهور في:

segments.src: - **Interest rates and borrowing costs**, shaped by how central banks understand inflation.
segments.tr: - **أسعار الفائدة وتكاليف الاقتراض**، والتي تُشكَّل بفعل فهم البنوك المركزية للتضخم.

segments.src: - **Wages and job security**, shaped by research on labor markets, trade and technology.
segments.tr: - **الأجور والأمان الوظيفي**، والتي تُشكَّل بالأبحاث حول أسواق العمل والتجارة والتكنولوجيا.

segments.src: - **Taxes and public programs**, shaped by evidence on inequality and what policies actually work.
segments.tr: - **الضرائب والبرامج العامة**، والتي تُشكَّل بالأدلة حول عدم المساواة والسياسات التي تنجح فعلياً.

segments.src: - **Prices**, shaped by trade rules, competition policy and energy markets.
segments.tr: - **الأسعار**، والتي تُشكَّل بقواعد التجارة وسياسة المنافسة وأسواق الطاقة.

segments.src: You do not need to follow every paper to benefit from knowing the basics.
segments.tr: لا تحتاج لمتابعة كل ورقة بحثية للاستفادة من معرفة الأساسيات.

segments.src: When the winners are announced, look for the plain-language explanation the committee publishes alongside the award.
segments.tr: عندما يتم إعلان الفائزين، ابحث عن الشرح باللغة البسيطة الذي تنشره اللجنة بجانب الجائزة.

segments.src: It usually summarizes the contribution in a few accessible pages.
segments.tr: وهو عادة يلخص المساهمة في صفحات قليلة يسيرة الوصول إليها.

segments.src: ## What to watch for
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب ترقبه

segments.src: - **The announcement itself:** the economics prize is traditionally announced on a Monday in October, after the other Nobel categories.
segments.tr: - **الإعلان نفسه:** تُعلن جائزة الاقتصاد تقليدياً في يوم إثنين من شهر أكتوبر، بعد فئات نوبل الأخرى.

segments.src: - **The citation:** the committee's wording reveals which idea it considers most important.
segments.tr: - **الاستشهاد:** صيغة اللجنة تكشف الفكرة التي تعتبرها الأكثر أهمية.

segments.src: - **The policy angle:** pay attention to how commentators connect the winning work to current debates on inflation, jobs and technology.
segments.tr: - **زاوية السياسة:** انتبه لكيفية ربط المعلقين لعمل الفائز بالنقاشات الحالية حول التضخم والوظائف والتكنولوجيا.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Whoever is honored, the prize is a reminder that economic ideas have practical consequences.
segments.tr: أياً من يتم تكريمه، فالجائزة هي تذكير بأن الأفكار الاقتصادية لها عواقب عملية.

segments.src: The research areas above are not abstract; they are tied to the cost of living, the job market and the choices governments make.
segments.tr: المجالات البحثية أعلاه ليست مجردة؛ فهي مرتبطة بتكلفة المعيشة وسوق العمل والخيارات التي تتخذها الحكومات.

segments.src: Following the announcement is a simple way to learn what economists think matters most right now.
segments.tr: متابعة الإعلان هي طريقة بسيطة لمعرفة ما يعتقد الاقتصاديون أنه الأهم حالياً.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and discussion only.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة للمعلومات العامة والنقاش فقط.

segments.src: It is not financial, investment or tax advice, and it does not predict the outcome of the prize.*
segments.tr: وليست نصيحة مالية أو استثمارية أو ضريبية، ولا تتنبأ بنتيجة الجائزة.*

segments.tr: Après une semaine d'annonces en science et en paix, l'attention se tourne vers le dernier des grands prix Nobel : le prix de sciences économiques, officiellement le prix de la Banque de Suède en sciences économiques en mémoire d'Alfred Nobel.

segments.tr: Pourtant, les domaines de recherche qui ont tendance à revenir dans ces conversations en disent long sur les questions sur lesquelles travaillent les économistes, et sur les forces qui façonnent les prix, les salaires et les perspectives d'emploi.

segments.tr: ## Tout d'abord, une mise en garde rapide

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## Domaines de recherche souvent discutés

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income
segments.tr: ### 1. Inégalité et répartition des revenus

segments.src: Why do some households pull ahead while others stall?
segments.tr: Pourquoi certains ménages s'en sortent-ils bien tandis que d'autres stagnent ?

segments.src: Work on wealth concentration, intergenerational mobility and the changing share of income going to labor versus capital has shaped debates about taxes, education funding and social programs.
segments.tr: Les travaux sur la concentration de la richesse, la mobilité intergénérationnelle et la part changeante du revenu allant au travail par rapport au capital ont façonné les débats sur les impôts, le financement de l'éducation et les programmes sociaux.

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs de tous les jours, cette recherche se cache derrière des questions telles que de savoir si les salaires suivent le coût de la vie et comment la politique fiscale affecte le salaire net.

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects
segments.tr: ### 2. Commerce, mondialisation et leurs effets locaux

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs qui étudient comment les importations, les tarifs douaniers et les chaînes d'approvisionnement affectent des villes et des industries spécifiques ont changé la conversation.

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: La conclusion selon laquelle les gains du commerce sont réels mais inégalement répartis aide à expliquer pourquoi la politique commerciale est si contestée.

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: Elle apparaît également dans le prix des biens sur les étagères des magasins et dans les emplois locaux qui croissent ou diminuent.

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. IA, automatisation et productivité

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: La nouvelle technologie peut-elle élever la productivité et les niveaux de vie, et qui en profite lorsqu'elle le fait ?

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: Les économistes examinent comment l'automatisation modifie les tâches que font les travailleurs, et pas seulement le nombre d'emplois.

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: La question centrale pour les ménages est pratique : les salaires augmenteront-ils à mesure que les outils s'améliorent, et quelles compétences conservent leur valeur ?

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: Les preuves sont encore en développement, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi le sujet attire autant d'attention.

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. Marchés du travail et fixation des salaires

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: Les études sur l'embauche, les changements d'emploi à emploi, le pouvoir de négociation et les salaires minimums ont changé la façon dont les économistes perçoivent la rémunération.

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: Cette ligne de travail informe la façon dont les décideurs politiques perçoivent l'emploi, et elle affecte directement les lecteurs lorsqu'ils négocient des salaires ou envisagent un changement de carrière.

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. Monnaie, inflation et banque centrale

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: Les récentes années de forte inflation ont remis l'économie monétaire sous les feux de la rampe.

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: La recherche sur les anticipations, les taux d'intérêt et la manière dont les banques centrales communiquent aide à expliquer pourquoi les coûts d'emprunt sur les hypothèques, les prêts automobiles et les cartes de crédit évoluent de la manière dont ils le font.

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. Climat, énergie et économie environnementale

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: Tarifer la pollution, concevoir des incitations et mesurer les coûts d'un climat en évolution sont désormais des questions économiques fondamentales.

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: Elles influencent les factures d'énergie, les coûts d'assurance et le coût à long terme des décisions d'investissement.

segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## Comment les idées des anciens gagnants sont devenues une politique du monde réel

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: Le prix a souvent honoré des travaux qui sont passés des revues académiques aux institutions de tous les jours :

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **Banque et stabilité financière (2022) :** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond et Philip Dybvig ont été récompensés pour leurs recherches sur les banques et les crises financières. Les travaux de Bernanke sur la Grande Dépression ont éclairé les réponses des banques centrales à la crise de 2008, y compris le prêt d'urgence et la réflexion sur la protection des dépôts.

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana ide pemenang masa lalu menjadi kebijakan dunia nyata

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: Penghargaan ini sering kali menghormati pekerjaan yang berpindah dari jurnal akademik ke institusi sehari-hari:

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **Perbankan dan stabilitas keuangan (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond, dan Philip Dybvig diakui atas penelitian tentang bank dan krisis keuangan. Pekerjaan Bernanke tentang Depresi Besar memberi tahu tanggapan bank sentral terhadap krisis 2008, termasuk pinjaman darurat dan pemikiran perlindungan deposit.

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **Eksperimen alami (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist, dan Guido Imbens menunjukkan bagaimana peristiwa dunia nyata dapat mengungkapkan sebab dan akibat. Studi Card tentang upah minimum, misalnya, menantang asumsi bahwa kenaikan selalu membebani pekerjaan dan membentuk bukti yang digunakan dalam perdebatan upah.

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **Pembangunan dan kemiskinan (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo, dan Michael Kremer mempopulerkan uji coba acak untuk menguji program anti-kemiskinan mana yang berhasil. Pemerintah dan badan amal kini secara rutin mengevaluasi program dengan cara ini.

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **Gender dan pekerjaan (2023):** Penelitian historis Claudia Goldin tentang partisipasi angkatan kerja perempuan dan kesenjangan upah menginformasikan diskusi yang sedang berlangsung tentang kebijakan tempat kerja dan biaya karier terkait keluarga.

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **Institusi dan kemakmuran (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, dan James Robinson menghubungkan kualitas institusi suatu negara dengan hasil ekonomi jangka panjang.

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **Inovasi dan pertumbuhan (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, dan Peter Howitt dihormati atas pekerjaan tentang bagaimana kemajuan teknologi mendorong pertumbuhan yang berkelanjutan, sebuah tema yang sangat terkait dengan percakapan AI hari ini.

segments.src: ## Why this matters for your wallet
segments.tr: ## Mengapa ini penting bagi dompet Anda

segments.src: It is easy to dismiss a prize announcement as an academic event.
segments.tr: Sangat mudah untuk mengabaikan pengumuman penghargaan sebagai acara akademik.

segments.src: But the ideas behind it tend to show up in:
segments.tr: Tetapi ide-ide di baliknya cenderung muncul dalam:

segments.src: - **Interest rates and borrowing costs**, shaped by how central banks understand inflation.
segments.tr: - **Suku bunga dan biaya pinjaman**, dibentuk oleh bagaimana bank sentral memahami inflasi.

segments.src: - **Wages and job security**, shaped by research on labor markets, trade and technology.
segments.tr: - **Upah dan keamanan kerja**, dibentuk oleh penelitian tentang pasar tenaga kerja, perdagangan, dan teknologi.

segments.src: - **Taxes and public programs**, shaped by evidence on inequality and what policies actually work.
segments.tr: - **Pajak dan program publik**, dibentuk oleh bukti tentang ketimpangan dan kebijakan apa yang benar-benar berhasil.

segments.src: - **Prices**, shaped by trade rules, competition policy and energy markets.
segments.tr: - **Harga**, dibentuk oleh aturan perdagangan, kebijakan persaingan, dan pasar energi.

segments.src: You do not need to follow every paper to benefit from knowing the basics.
segments.tr: Anda tidak perlu mengikuti setiap makalah untuk mendapat manfaat dari mengetahui dasarnya.

segments.src: After a week of announcements in science and peace, attention turns to the last of the major Nobel awards: the Prize in Economic Sciences, formally the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
segments.tr: 科学や平和に関する賞の発表が1週間続いた後、注目は主要なノーベル賞の最後の一つ、経済学賞（正式名称：アルフレッド・ノーベル記念スウェーデン国立銀行経済学賞）へと移ります。

segments.src: The committee never publishes a shortlist, so any list of contenders is educated guessing.
segments.tr: 選考委員会は候補者リストを公表しないため、有力候補のリストはあくまで専門家による推測に過ぎません。

segments.src: Still, the research areas that tend to come up in these conversations say a lot about the questions economists are working on, and about the forces that shape prices, paychecks and job prospects.
segments.tr: それでも、こうした議論の中で頻繁に取り上げられる研究分野は、経済学者がどのような問いに取り組んでいるのか、そして価格や給与、雇用の見通しを形作る力について多くのことを物語っています。

segments.src: ## First, a quick caveat
segments.tr: ## まず、簡単な注意点

segments.src: The selection process is confidential, and nominations stay sealed for decades.
segments.tr: 選考プロセスは機密であり、推薦内容は数十年にわたって封印されます。

segments.src: Commentators build their lists from citation counts, past awards and the themes dominating the field.
segments.tr: 解説者たちは、被引用数や過去の受賞歴、そしてその分野で支配的なテーマに基づいてリストを作成しています。

segments.src: Treat the areas below as a guide to where economics is heading, not as a forecast of who will win.
segments.tr: 以下の分野は、誰が受賞するかを予測するものではなく、経済学がどこに向かっているかを示すガイドとして捉えてください。

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## よく議論される研究分野

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income
segments.tr: ### 1. 不平等と所得分配

segments.src: Why do some households pull ahead while others stall?
segments.tr: なぜ一部の世帯は豊かになり、他の世帯は停滞するのでしょうか？

segments.src: Work on wealth concentration, intergenerational mobility and the changing share of income going to labor versus capital has shaped debates about taxes, education funding and social programs.
segments.tr: 富の集中、世代間の流動性、そして労働と資本に分配される所得シェアの変化に関する研究は、税金、教育資金、社会プログラムに関する議論を形作ってきました。

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: 一般の読者にとって、この研究は、賃金が生活費の上昇に追いついているか、税制が手取り収入にどのような影響を与えるかといった疑問の背景にあります。

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects
segments.tr: ### 2. 貿易、グローバル化、そして地域への影響

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: 輸入、関税、サプライチェーンが特定の町や産業にどのような影響を与えるかを研究する専門家たちは、議論のあり方を変えてきました。

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: 貿易による利益は現実のものですが、その分配は不均等であるという発見は、なぜ貿易政策がこれほどまでに争点となるのかを説明する助けとなります。

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: また、それは店頭に並ぶ商品の価格や、どの地域の雇用が拡大し、どの地域が縮小するのかにも表れています。

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. AI、自動化、生産性

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: 新しい技術は生産性と生活水準を向上させることができるのでしょうか。また、向上した場合、誰が恩恵を受けるのでしょうか？

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: 経済学者は、自動化が単に雇用の数だけでなく、労働者が行うタスクをどのように変えるかを検証しています。

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: 世帯にとっての核心的な問いは現実的です。ツールが改善されるにつれて賃金は上がるのか、そしてどのスキルが価値を維持するのかということです。

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: このトピックがこれほど注目を集めている理由の一部は、その証拠がまだ発展途上であるためです。

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. 労働市場と賃金決定の仕組み

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: 雇用、転職、交渉力、最低賃金に関する研究は、経済学者が賃金をどのように考えるかを変えてきました。

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: この分野の研究は、政策立案者が雇用をどう捉えるかに影響を与え、読者が給与交渉をしたり、キャリアチェンジを検討したりする際に直接的な影響を及ぼします。

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. 通貨、インフレ、中央銀行

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: 近年の高インフレにより、金融経済学が再び脚光を浴びています。

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: 期待、金利、中央銀行のコミュニケーションに関する研究は、住宅ローン、自動車ローン、クレジットカードの借入コストがなぜ変動するのかを説明するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. 気候、エネルギー、環境経済学

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: 汚染への価格付け、インセンティブの設計、気候変動に伴うコストの測定は、今や経済学の核心的な問いとなっています。

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: これらはエネルギー料金、保険料、そして投資判断の長期的なコストに影響を与えます。

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: Für alltägliche Leser steht diese Forschung hinter Fragen wie der, ob die Gehälter mit den Lebenshaltungskosten Schritt halten und wie die Steuerpolitik das Nettogehalt beeinflusst.

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.

segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## Wie die Ideen früherer Gewinner zu realer Politik wurden

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: Der Preis hat oft Arbeiten geehrt, die den Sprung von akademischen Fachzeitschriften in alltägliche Institutionen geschafft haben:

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **Banken und Finanzstabilität (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond und Philip Dybvig wurden für Forschungen zu Banken und Finanzkrisen ausgezeichnet. Bernankes Arbeit über die Große Depression beeinflusste die Reaktionen der Zentralbanken auf die Krise von 2008, einschließlich Notkrediten und dem Denken zum Einlagenschutz.

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **Natürliche Experimente (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist und Guido Imbens zeigten, wie reale Ereignisse Ursache und Wirkung aufdecken können. Cards Studien zum Mindestlohn forderten beispielsweise die Annahme heraus, dass Erhöhungen immer Arbeitsplätze kosten, und prägten die in Lohndebatten verwendete Beweislage.

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **Entwicklung und Armut (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo und Michael Kremer machten randomisierte Studien populär, um zu testen, welche Antiarmutsprogramme funktionieren. Regierungen und Wohltätigkeitsorganisationen bewerten Programme nun routinemäßig auf diese Weise.

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **Geschlecht und Arbeit (2023):** Claudia Goldins historische Forschung zur Erwerbsbeteiligung von Frauen und dem Lohngefälle prägte laufende Diskussionen über Arbeitsplatzpolitik und familienbedingte Karriereosten.

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **Institutionen und Wohlstand (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson und James Robinson verknüpften die Qualität der Institutionen eines Landes mit langfristigen wirtschaftlichen Ergebnissen.

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **Innovation und Wachstum (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion und Peter Howitt wurden für Arbeiten darüber geehrt, wie technologischer Fortschritt dauerhaftes Wachstum antreibt, ein Thema, das eng mit der heutigen KI-Diskussion verknüpft ist.

Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **Thí nghiệm tự nhiên (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist và Guido Imbens đã chỉ ra cách các sự kiện trong thế giới thực có thể tiết lộ nguyên nhân và kết quả. Ví dụ, các nghiên cứu của Card về mức lương tối thiểu đã thách thức giả định rằng việc tăng lương luôn làm mất việc làm và định hình các bằng chứng được sử dụng trong các cuộc tranh luận về tiền lương.

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **Phát triển và nghèo đói (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo và Michael Kremer đã phổ biến các thử nghiệm ngẫu nhiên để kiểm tra chương trình chống nghèo đói nào hiệu quả. Chính phủ và các tổ chức từ thiện hiện thường xuyên đánh giá các chương trình theo cách này.

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **Giới tính và công việc (2023):** Nghiên cứu lịch sử của Claudia Goldin về sự tham gia lực lượng lao động của phụ nữ và khoảng cách tiền lương đã cung cấp thông tin cho các cuộc thảo luận đang diễn ra về chính sách nơi làm việc và chi phí sự nghiệp liên quan đến gia đình.

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **Các thể chế và sự thịnh vượng (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson và James Robinson đã liên kết chất lượng các thể chế của một quốc gia với kết quả kinh tế dài hạn.

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **Đổi mới và tăng trưởng (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion và Peter Howitt đã được vinh danh vì công trình nghiên cứu về cách tiến bộ công nghệ thúc đẩy tăng trưởng bền vững, một chủ đề gắn chặt chẽ với cuộc trò chuyện về AI ngày nay.

segments.src: ## Why this matters for your wallet
segments.tr: ## Tại sao điều này quan trọng đối với ví tiền của bạn

segments.src: It is easy to dismiss a prize announcement as an academic event.
segments.tr: Thật dễ dàng để bỏ qua một thông báo giải thưởng như một sự kiện học thuật.

segments.src: But the ideas behind it tend to show up in:
segments.tr: Nhưng những ý tưởng đằng sau nó thường xuất hiện trong:

segments.src: - **Interest rates and borrowing costs**, shaped by how central banks understand inflation.
segments.tr: - **Lãi suất và chi phí đi vay**, được định hình bởi cách các ngân hàng trung ương hiểu về lạm phát.

segments.src: - **Wages and job security**, shaped by research on labor markets, trade and technology.
segments.tr: - **Tiền lương và an ninh việc làm**, được định hình bởi nghiên cứu về thị trường lao động, thương mại và công nghệ.

segments.src: - **Taxes and public programs**, shaped by evidence on inequality and what policies actually work.
segments.tr: - **Thuế và các chương trình công cộng**, được định hình bởi bằng chứng về bất bình đẳng và những chính sách nào thực sự hiệu quả.

segments.src: - **Prices**, shaped by trade rules, competition policy and energy markets.
segments.tr: - **Giá cả**, được định hình bởi các quy tắc thương mại, chính sách cạnh tranh và thị trường năng lượng.

segments.src: You do not need to follow every paper to benefit from knowing the basics.
segments.tr: Bạn không cần phải theo dõi mọi tài liệu để hưởng lợi từ việc biết những điều cơ bản.

segments.src: When the winners are announced, look for the plain-language explanation the committee publishes alongside the award.
segments.tr: Khi những người chiến thắng được công bố, hãy tìm kiếm lời giải thích bằng ngôn ngữ đơn giản mà ủy ban công bố bên cạnh giải thưởng.

segments.src: It usually summarizes the contribution in a few accessible pages.
segments.tr: Nó thường tóm tắt sự đóng góp trong một vài trang dễ tiếp cận.

segments.src: ## What to watch for
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần chú ý

segments.src: - **The announcement itself:** the economics prize is traditionally announced on a Monday in October, after the other Nobel categories.
segments.tr: - **Bản thân thông báo:** giải thưởng kinh tế thường được công bố vào một ngày Thứ Hai trong tháng Mười, sau các danh mục Nobel khác.

segments.src: - **The citation:** the committee's wording reveals which idea it considers most important.
segments.tr: - **Trích dẫn:** cách dùng từ của ủy ban tiết lộ ý tưởng nào mà họ cho là quan trọng nhất.

segments.src: - **The policy angle:** pay attention to how commentators connect the winning work to current debates on inflation, jobs and technology.
segments.tr: - **Góc nhìn chính sách:** hãy chú ý đến cách các nhà bình luận kết nối công trình giành giải thưởng với các cuộc tranh luận hiện tại về lạm phát, việc làm và công nghệ.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Whoever is honored, the prize is a reminder that economic ideas have practical consequences.
segments.tr: Dù ai được vinh danh, giải thưởng là lời nhắc nhở rằng các ý tưởng kinh tế có hậu quả thực tế.

segments.src: The research areas above are not abstract; they are tied to the cost of living, the job market and the choices governments make.
segments.tr: Các lĩnh vực nghiên cứu trên không phải là trừu tượng; chúng gắn liền với chi phí sinh hoạt, thị trường việc làm và các lựa chọn mà chính phủ đưa ra.

segments.src: Following the announcement is a simple way to learn what economists think matters most right now.
segments.tr: Theo dõi thông báo là một cách đơn giản để tìm hiểu những gì các nhà kinh tế học nghĩ là quan trọng nhất ngay bây giờ.

hi.title: अगला अर्थशास्त्र नोबेल: कौन से बड़े विचार जीत सकते हैं, और वे आपके बटुए के लिए क्यों मायने रखते हैं

segments.src: After a week of announcements in science and peace, attention turns to the last of the major Nobel awards: the Prize in Economic Sciences, formally the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
segments.tr: विज्ञान और शांति के क्षेत्र में घोषणाओं के एक सप्ताह के बाद, ध्यान नोबेल के अंतिम प्रमुख पुरस्कार की ओर मुड़ता है: आर्थिक विज्ञान में पुरस्कार, जिसे औपचारिक रूप से अल्फ्रेड नोबेल की स्मृति में आर्थिक विज्ञान में स्वेरिजेस रिक्सबैंक पुरस्कार कहा जाता है।

segments.src: The committee never publishes a shortlist, so any list of contenders is educated guessing.
segments.tr: समिति कभी भी शॉर्टलिस्ट प्रकाशित नहीं करती है, इसलिए दावेदारों की कोई भी सूची केवल शिक्षित अनुमान है।

segments.src: Still, the research areas that tend to come up in these conversations say a lot about the questions economists are working on, and about the forces that shape prices, paychecks and job prospects.
segments.tr: फिर भी, जिन शोध क्षेत्रों पर इन चर्चाओं में अक्सर बात होती है, वे उन सवालों के बारे में बहुत कुछ बताते हैं जिन पर अर्थशास्त्री काम कर रहे हैं, और उन ताकतों के बारे में जो कीमतों, वेतन और नौकरी की संभावनाओं को आकार देती हैं।

segments.src: ## First, a quick caveat
segments.tr: ## सबसे पहले, एक त्वरित चेतावनी

segments.src: The selection process is confidential, and nominations stay sealed for decades.
segments.tr: चयन प्रक्रिया गोपनीय होती है, और नामांकन दशकों तक सीलबंद रहते हैं।

segments.src: Commentators build their lists from citation counts, past awards and the themes dominating the field.
segments.tr: टिप्पणीकार उद्धरण गणनाओं, पिछले पुरस्कारों और क्षेत्र में हावी विषयों से अपनी सूची तैयार करते हैं।

segments.src: Treat the areas below as a guide to where economics is heading, not as a forecast of who will win.
segments.tr: नीचे दिए गए क्षेत्रों को इस बात के गाइड के रूप में देखें कि अर्थशास्त्र किस दिशा में आगे बढ़ रहा है, न कि इस पूर्वानुमान के रूप में कि कौन जीतेगा।

segments.src: ## Research areas often discussed
segments.tr: ## अक्सर चर्चा किए जाने वाले शोध क्षेत्र

segments.src: ### 1. Inequality and the distribution of income
segments.tr: ### 1. असमानता और आय का वितरण

segments.src: Why do some households pull ahead while others stall?
segments.tr: कुछ परिवार आगे क्यों निकल जाते हैं जबकि अन्य पीछे रह जाते हैं?

segments.src: Work on wealth concentration, intergenerational mobility and the changing share of income going to labor versus capital has shaped debates about taxes, education funding and social programs.
segments.tr: धन के संकेंद्रण, अंतर-पीढ़ीगत गतिशीलता और श्रम बनाम पूंजी के लिए जाने वाली आय के बदलते हिस्से पर काम ने करों, शिक्षा निधि और सामाजिक कार्यक्रमों के बारे में बहस को आकार दिया है।

segments.src: For everyday readers, this research sits behind questions such as whether wages keep pace with the cost of living and how tax policy affects take-home pay.
segments.tr: आम पाठकों के लिए, यह शोध उन सवालों के पीछे है जैसे कि क्या वेतन जीवन यापन की लागत के साथ तालमेल रखता है और कर नीति टेक-होम वेतन को कैसे प्रभावित करती है।

segments.src: ### 2. Trade, globalization and their local effects
segments.tr: ### 2. व्यापार, वैश्वीकरण और उनके स्थानीय प्रभाव

segments.src: Researchers who study how imports, tariffs and supply chains affect specific towns and industries have changed the conversation.
segments.tr: जो शोधकर्ता यह अध्ययन करते हैं कि आयात, टैरिफ और आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाएं विशिष्ट कस्बों और उद्योगों को कैसे प्रभावित करती हैं, उन्होंने बातचीत को बदल दिया है।

segments.src: The finding that the gains from trade are real but unevenly spread helps explain why trade policy is so contested.
segments.tr: यह निष्कर्ष कि व्यापार से लाभ वास्तविक हैं लेकिन असमान रूप से फैले हुए हैं, यह समझाने में मदद करता है कि व्यापार नीति इतनी विवादास्पद क्यों है।

segments.src: It also shows up in the price of goods on store shelves and in which local jobs grow or shrink.
segments.tr: यह स्टोर की अलमारियों पर वस्तुओं की कीमत में और इस बात में भी दिखता है कि कौन सी स्थानीय नौकरियां बढ़ती हैं या घटती हैं।

segments.src: ### 3. AI, automation and productivity
segments.tr: ### 3. एआई, स्वचालन और उत्पादकता

segments.src: Can new technology lift productivity and living standards, and who benefits when it does?
segments.tr: क्या नई तकनीक उत्पादकता और जीवन स्तर को बढ़ा सकती है, और जब ऐसा होता है तो किसे लाभ होता है?

segments.src: Economists are examining how automation changes the tasks workers do, not just the number of jobs.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री यह जांच कर रहे हैं कि स्वचालन कैसे उन कार्यों को बदलता है जो श्रमिक करते हैं, न कि केवल नौकरियों की संख्या को।

segments.src: The central question for households is practical: will wages rise as tools improve, and which skills keep their value?
segments.tr: परिवारों के लिए केंद्रीय सवाल व्यावहारिक है: क्या उपकरणों में सुधार के साथ वेतन बढ़ेगा, और कौन से कौशल अपना मूल्य बनाए रखेंगे?

segments.src: The evidence is still developing, which is part of why the topic draws so much attention.
segments.tr: साक्ष्य अभी भी विकसित हो रहे हैं, जो इस बात का हिस्सा है कि यह विषय इतना ध्यान क्यों आकर्षित करता है।

segments.src: ### 4. Labor markets and how wages are set
segments.tr: ### 4. श्रम बाजार और वेतन कैसे तय होते हैं

segments.src: Studies of hiring, job-to-job moves, bargaining power and minimum wages have changed how economists think about pay.
segments.tr: भर्ती, नौकरी से नौकरी में बदलाव, सौदेबाजी की शक्ति और न्यूनतम वेतन के अध्ययनों ने अर्थशास्त्रियों के वेतन के बारे में सोचने के तरीके को बदल दिया है।

segments.src: This line of work informs how policymakers view employment, and it affects readers directly when they negotiate salaries or weigh a career change.
segments.tr: काम की यह पंक्ति सूचित करती है कि नीति निर्माता रोजगार को कैसे देखते हैं, और यह पाठकों को सीधे प्रभावित करती है जब वे वेतन पर बातचीत करते हैं या करियर बदलने पर विचार करते हैं।

segments.src: ### 5. Money, inflation and central banking
segments.tr: ### 5. पैसा, मुद्रास्फीति और केंद्रीय बैंकिंग

segments.src: Recent years of high inflation put monetary economics back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: उच्च मुद्रास्फीति के हालिया वर्षों ने मौद्रिक अर्थशास्त्र को वापस सुर्खियों में ला दिया है।

segments.src: Research on expectations, interest rates and how central banks communicate helps explain why borrowing costs on mortgages, car loans and credit cards move the way they do.
segments.tr: अपेक्षाओं, ब्याज दरों और केंद्रीय बैंक कैसे संवाद करते हैं, इस पर शोध यह समझाने में मदद करता है कि बंधक, कार ऋण और क्रेडिट कार्ड पर उधार लेने की लागत उस तरह क्यों चलती है जैसे वे चलती हैं।

segments.src: ### 6. Climate, energy and environmental economics
segments.tr: ### 6. जलवायु, ऊर्जा और पर्यावरण अर्थशास्त्र

segments.src: Pricing pollution, designing incentives and measuring the costs of a changing climate are now core economic questions.
segments.tr: प्रदूषण की कीमत तय करना, प्रोत्साहन डिजाइन करना और बदलती जलवायु की लागत को मापना अब मुख्य आर्थिक सवाल हैं।

segments.src: They influence energy bills, insurance costs and the long-term cost of investment decisions.
segments.tr: वे ऊर्जा बिलों, बीमा लागतों और निवेश निर्णयों की दीर्घकालिक लागत को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## How past winners' ideas became real-world policy
segments.tr: ## पिछले विजेताओं के विचार वास्तविक दुनिया की नीति कैसे बने

segments.src: The prize has often honored work that moved from academic journals into everyday institutions:
segments.tr: पुरस्कार ने अक्सर उस काम को सम्मानित किया है जो अकादमिक पत्रिकाओं से रोजमर्रा की संस्थाओं में चला गया:

segments.src: - **Banking and financial stability (2022):** Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig were recognized for research on banks and financial crises. Bernanke's work on the Great Depression informed central banks' responses to the 2008 crisis, including emergency lending and deposit-protection thinking.
segments.tr: - **बैंकिंग और वित्तीय स्थिरता (2022):** बेन बर्नानके, डगलस डायमंड और फिलिप डायबविग को बैंकों और वित्तीय संकटों पर शोध के लिए मान्यता दी गई थी। महामंदी पर बर्नानके के काम ने 2008 के संकट के प्रति केंद्रीय बैंकों की प्रतिक्रियाओं को सूचित किया, जिसमें आपातकालीन ऋण और जमा-सुरक्षा सोच शामिल है।

segments.src: - **Natural experiments (2021):** David Card, Joshua Angrist and Guido Imbens showed how real-world events can reveal cause and effect. Card's studies of the minimum wage, for example, challenged the assumption that increases always cost jobs and shaped the evidence used in wage debates.
segments.tr: - **प्राकृतिक प्रयोग (2021):** डेविड कार्ड, जोशुआ एंग्रिस्ट और गुइडो इम्बेन्स ने दिखाया कि कैसे वास्तविक दुनिया की घटनाएं कारण और प्रभाव को प्रकट कर सकती हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, न्यूनतम वेतन के कार्ड के अध्ययनों ने इस धारणा को चुनौती दी कि वृद्धि हमेशा नौकरियों की कीमत पर होती है और वेतन बहस में उपयोग किए जाने वाले साक्ष्यों को आकार दिया।

segments.src: - **Development and poverty (2019):** Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer popularized randomized trials to test which anti-poverty programs work. Governments and charities now routinely evaluate programs this way.
segments.tr: - **विकास और गरीबी (2019):** अभिजीत बनर्जी, एस्तेर डुफ्लो और माइकल क्रेमर ने यह परीक्षण करने के लिए यादृच्छिक परीक्षणों को लोकप्रिय बनाया कि कौन से गरीबी-विरोधी कार्यक्रम काम करते हैं। सरकारें और धर्मार्थ संस्थाएं अब नियमित रूप से इस तरह से कार्यक्रमों का मूल्यांकन करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Gender and work (2023):** Claudia Goldin's historical research on women's labor-force participation and the pay gap informed ongoing discussions about workplace policy and family-related career costs.
segments.tr: - **लिंग और काम (2023):** महिलाओं की श्रम-शक्ति भागीदारी और वेतन अंतर पर क्लाउडिया गोल्डिन के ऐतिहासिक शोध ने कार्यस्थल नीति और परिवार से संबंधित करियर लागतों के बारे में चल रही चर्चाओं को सूचित किया।

segments.src: - **Institutions and prosperity (2024):** Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson and James Robinson linked the quality of a country's institutions to long-run economic outcomes.
segments.tr: - **संस्थान और समृद्धि (2024):** डारोन एसेमोग्लू, साइमन जॉनसन और जेम्स रॉबिन्सन ने किसी देश के संस्थानों की गुणवत्ता को दीर्घकालिक आर्थिक परिणामों से जोड़ा।

segments.src: - **Innovation and growth (2025):** Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt were honored for work on how technological progress drives sustained growth, a theme closely tied to today's AI conversation.
segments.tr: - **नवाचार और विकास (2025):** जोएल मोकिर, फिलिप एगियन और पीटर हॉविट को इस काम के लिए सम्मानित किया गया कि कैसे तकनीकी प्रगति निरंतर विकास को प्रेरित करती है, एक ऐसा विषय जो आज की एआई बातचीत से निकटता से जुड़ा हुआ है।

segments.src: ## Why this matters for your wallet
segments.tr: ## यह आपके बटुए के लिए क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: It is easy to dismiss a prize announcement as an academic event.
segments.tr: पुरस्कार की घोषणा को एक अकादमिक घटना के रूप में खारिज करना आसान है।

segments.src: But the ideas behind it tend to show up in:
segments.tr: लेकिन इसके पीछे के विचार अक्सर इनमें दिखाई देते हैं:

segments.src: - **Interest rates and borrowing costs**, shaped by how central banks understand inflation.
segments.tr: - **ब्याज दरें और उधार लेने की लागत**, जो इस बात से आकार लेती है कि केंद्रीय बैंक मुद्रास्फीति को कैसे समझते हैं।

segments.src: - **Wages and job security**, shaped by research on labor markets, trade and technology.
segments.tr: - **वेतन और नौकरी की सुरक्षा**, जो श्रम बाजार, व्यापार और तकनीक पर शोध से आकार लेती है।

segments.src: - **Taxes and public programs**, shaped by evidence on inequality and what policies actually work.
segments.tr: - **कर और सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम**, जो असमानता और वास्तव में कौन सी नीतियां काम करती हैं, इस पर साक्ष्य से आकार लेते हैं।

segments.src: - **Prices**, shaped by trade rules, competition policy and energy markets.
segments.tr: - **कीमतें**, जो व्यापार नियमों, प्रतिस्पर्धा नीति और ऊर्जा बाजारों से आकार लेती हैं।

segments.src: You do not need to follow every paper to benefit from knowing the basics.
segments.tr: मूल बातें जानने से लाभ उठाने के लिए आपको हर पेपर का पालन करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: When the winners are announced, look for the plain-language explanation the committee publishes alongside the award.
segments.tr: जब विजेताओं की घोषणा की जाती है, तो पुरस्कार के साथ समिति द्वारा प्रकाशित सरल भाषा की व्याख्या देखें।

segments.src: It usually summarizes the contribution in a few accessible pages.
segments.tr: यह आमतौर पर कुछ सुलभ पृष्ठों में योगदान का सारांश देता है।

segments.src: ## What to watch for
segments.tr: ## क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **The announcement itself:** the economics prize is traditionally announced on a Monday in October, after the other Nobel categories.
segments.tr: - **स्वयं घोषणा:** अर्थशास्त्र पुरस्कार की घोषणा पारंपरिक रूप से अक्टूबर में एक सोमवार को की जाती है, अन्य नोबेल श्रेणियों के बाद।

segments.src: - **The citation:** the committee's wording reveals which idea it considers most important.
segments.tr: - **उद्धरण:** समिति की शब्दावली यह प्रकट करती है कि वह किस विचार को सबसे महत्वपूर्ण मानती है।

segments.src: - **The policy angle:** pay attention to how commentators connect the winning work to current debates on inflation, jobs and technology.
segments.tr: - **नीति कोण:** इस पर ध्यान दें कि टिप्पणीकार विजेता काम को मुद्रास्फीति, नौकरियों और तकनीक पर वर्तमान बहसों से कैसे जोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Whoever is honored, the prize is a reminder that economic ideas have practical consequences.
segments.tr: चाहे जिसे भी सम्मानित किया जाए, पुरस्कार एक अनुस्मारक है कि आर्थिक विचारों के व्यावहारिक परिणाम होते हैं।

segments.src: The research areas above are not abstract; they are tied to the cost of living, the job market and the choices governments make.
segments.tr: ऊपर दिए गए शोध क्षेत्र अमूर्त नहीं हैं; वे जीवन यापन की लागत, नौकरी बाजार और सरकारों द्वारा लिए जाने वाले निर्णयों से जुड़े हैं।

segments.src: Following the announcement is a simple way to learn what economists think matters most right now.
segments.tr: घोषणा का पालन करना यह जानने का एक सरल तरीका है कि अर्थशास्त्री अभी क्या सबसे महत्वपूर्ण मानते हैं।
